equity_bridge.item: Investment securities (cross-shareholdings, FVTOCI) at 80% of carrying value
equity_bridge.note: 97,411 at 30 Sep 2026 (4528.T_HalfYear_H1-2026.txt:542); 20% haircut for embedded tax on gains and illiquidity. Matching-asset rule: dividend/interest income is stripped from the flows, so the asset enters the bridge.
30 Sep 2026 balance sheet (line 592); flows are consolidated.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: base-case 10-year revenue CAGR (FY2026 515.8bn -> FY2036 395.8bn); the historical equity CAGR (6.0%) is not a forward proxy for a company facing a dated royalty cliff
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR 6.0% vs revenue 10.8% (44% lower) and EPS -0.4%: revenue growth was Opdivo royalty plus the Deciphera consolidation while EPS fell on R&D (+140% over 5 years), acquisition amortization and one-offs. Owner-FCF 3yr CAGR -17.5% off the FY2023 peak (145bn, flattered by a 6.6bn cash-tax year).
historical_growth.notes: CAGRs on the owner-FCF series (reported FCF - SBC - interest income): FY2021 51,182 / FY2023 142,569 / FY2026 80,047. SBC is immaterial so owner and reported CAGRs differ only by the interest strip. Periods: FY2021 = year ended Mar 2021, FY2026 = year ended Mar 2026.

scenario_narratives.base: The Opdivo royalty annuity (173bn in FY2026, 185bn guided FY2027, ~34-40% of revenue and most of the profit) runs down on its contractual calendar: the Merck Keytruda settlement royalty stops after Dec 2026, US Opdivo IV exclusivity lapses in 2028, EU/ROW in 2030, leaving a subcutaneous-formulation and Braftovi/other tail of ~40-50bn into the 2030s. Domestic product sales keep shrinking on NHI price cuts and generic entry (Forxiga co-promotion already gone, hence the -11.8% guided FY2027). Deciphera's QINLOCK/ROMVIMZA grow from ~65bn to ~90bn+ and one or two of sapablursen, ONO-4578 and povetacicept (Japan) launch 2029-31, so revenue stabilises near 375bn by FY2032 and grows ~2% thereafter. Management keeps R&D above 30% of sales through the cliff, so EBITDA margin troughs at 18.5% before cost discipline and new-product mix lift it to 21%. Net cash of 158bn plus 97bn of investment securities and a deleveraging balance sheet underwrite the 80/share dividend through the transition.
scenario_narratives.bull: Biosimilar nivolumab erodes slowly (IO biosimilars face heavier substitution friction than small molecules, and BMS converts 30-40% of US volume to subcutaneous Qvantig whose exclusivity runs well into the 2030s), so the royalty stream falls by roughly half rather than three-quarters by FY2032. Deciphera reaches $700m+ as ROMVIMZA penetrates TGCT and QINLOCK moves to earlier GIST lines and Japan; two pipeline assets (sapablursen in polycythemia vera, ONO-4578) reach near-simultaneous global approval using Deciphera's US/EU infrastructure, adding ~80bn of revenue by FY2033. Revenue troughs at ~430bn and grows 3% a year from FY2034; R&D is redirected rather than cut, and EBITDA margin recovers to 25.5% with a 17x terminal multiple on a re-rated pipeline-driven franchise.
scenario_narratives.bear: The cliff arrives faster and nothing replaces it: Keytruda royalty ends on schedule, US biosimilars launch promptly in 2028 and take 60%+ of IV volume within two years, EU expiry in 2030 does the same, and the subQ tail is thinner than hoped. Domestic Opdivo loses share to competing PD-1s and successive NHI cuts; the FY2025-26 attrition pattern (gastric, bladder, adjuvant HCC, five early oncology assets discontinued) continues, so R&D at ~30% of a shrinking revenue base produces no scale launch before FY2033. Deciphera plateaus near $450m. Revenue falls to ~270bn by FY2033 and EBITDA margin collapses to 10.5-13% because management, with 158bn of net cash and a never-cut dividend, is slow to right-size R&D. The company survives (no scenario hits the zero-TV floor) but becomes a sub-scale domestic pharma on a 13x terminal multiple.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value a running-off royalty annuity plus a mid-cap Japanese pharma that has to rebuild its revenue base with the cash that annuity throws off. The DCF is a 10-year explicit build because the margin is still moving (down, then up) through year seven; the terminal value is capped at 15x owner FCF so the valuation does not lean on a post-cliff Gordon multiple. All risk is charged in the flows at one JPY WACC; net cash, investment securities (haircut 20%) and NCI go through the bridge; leases are an operating cost; non-deductible Deciphera amortization is excluded from both the tax shield and the add-back. House and street bases coincide (SBC ~0.01% of revenue).
key_risks_to_valuation: Royalty run-off shape: the model assumes ~75% of FY2027 royalty income is gone by FY2032; every ¥10bn/yr of durable royalty tail is worth roughly ¥100-130/share
R&D response: the trough margin assumes management trims R&D from 31% toward 25% of sales by FY2033; a Takeda-style refusal to cut would push the base toward the bear path
Pipeline binary outcomes (sapablursen, ONO-4578, povetacicept-Japan): the base gives partial credit; the bull/bear spread is mostly these
FX: royalties and Deciphera sales are USD/EUR; guidance assumes USD/JPY 155, and a 10% stronger yen takes ~¥20bn off revenue at near-full margin
Investment-securities haircut and cross-shareholding unwind: 97bn carried at 80%; the full value is ¥41/share more
Terminal multiple: the 15x cap binds in the base case; at the 7% Gordon value the base IV would be ~¥150/share higher

inputs.sbc_source: FY2026 (year ended 31 Mar 2026) annual, cash-flow statement 'Share-based payments' 47 (4528.T_Annual_FY2025.txt:874); no equity-award taxes (SBC-zero market). H1 FY2027 shows 698m, a new restricted-stock plan, still <0.3% of revenue.
inputs.fy_label_note: CSV/repo labels are END-year: FY2026 = year ended 31 Mar 2026 (the company calls it 'FY2025'); forecast Y1 = FY2027 = year ending 31 Mar 2027 (company 'FY2026' guidance).
inputs.share_count_basis: 470.52m shares outstanding at 30 Sep 2026 (498.69m issued less treasury); diluted = basic to within rounding because share-based awards are immaterial. Held FLAT: SBC is expensed in the flows. Buybacks: ¥50bn in FY2024, nil since; the flat count is a convention the company funds opportunistically.
inputs.net_debt_note: Bank loans only: short-term 40,505 + long-term 60,000 = 100,505 (Deciphera acquisition debt, down from ~150,000 at drawdown). Cash and equivalents 258,178. Lease liabilities 9,483 EXCLUDED (lease treatment B). Interest income 3,457 (FY2026 finance income ex-FX) stripped from last_fcf because net cash is ~2x the FCF base. Investment securities 97,411 (cross-shareholdings/FVTOCI) carried in equity_bridge, not in cash.
inputs.wacc_rationale: JPY-built: 10y JGB ~1.8%, Japan ERP ~5.5%, beta ~0.8 for a net-cash, non-cyclical pharma with a royalty annuity -> cost of equity ~6.2-6.5%; the 20% debt weight at ~1.5% after-tax pulls lower. Rounded UP to 7.0% to keep the terminal value honest given 45%+ of value sits in a post-royalty-cliff terminal. Same WACC in all three scenarios: the royalty cliff, pipeline attrition and Deciphera execution are charged in the flows, not the rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: B (operating cost): full lease payment (principal ~3.3bn + interest ~0.15bn = 0.8% of revenue) deducted inside EBITDA via lease_cost_pct_path; lease liabilities 9,483 excluded from net debt; da_pct is D&A ex right-of-use depreciation ex acquisition amortization.
inputs.da_and_tax_note: da_pct (2.2%) is DEDUCTIBLE D&A only: FY2026 total D&A 37,752 less 25,600 Deciphera intangible amortization (share deal, no tax step-up, excluded from core OP) less ~3,300 ROU depreciation. The non-deductible amortization is therefore neither a tax shield nor an add-back, so cash tax is charged on EBIT ~= core operating profit. Cash tax 25% vs 30.6% statutory reflects the Japanese R&D credit (core tax/core OP guided ~25% for FY2027: core OP 124.0bn -> core profit 93.0bn).
inputs.nci_treatment: NCI stock 6,015 deducted in equity_bridge; flows are consolidated (NCI profit share ~0.2%, immaterial).
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF component DCF (operating pharma; routed via dcf-methods SKILL.md row 2, non-US adaptations applied: JPY WACC, lease treatment B, matching-asset rule for investment securities, SBC-zero band). FY0 = FY2026 (year ended 31 Mar 2026). The build is a managed-decline-then-stabilise path: Y1 is the company's own FY2027 guidance (revenue 455.0bn, -11.8% on the Forxiga co-promotion loss; core OP 124.0bn; R&D 143bn; royalty 185bn); Y2 loses the Merck Keytruda settlement royalty (2.5% x 25% Ono share, ends Dec 2026, ~¥25-30bn/yr); Y3-Y4 US Opdivo IV exclusivity lapses (2028); Y5-Y6 EU/ROW expiry (2030). Royalty income is near-pure margin, so the EBITDA margin compresses from ~30% to ~18.5% at the FY2032 trough and recovers to 21% as R&D normalises toward 25% of sales and Deciphera (QINLOCK/ROMVIMZA), the subcutaneous Opdivo royalty tail and 2029-31 pipeline launches (sapablursen, ONO-4578, povetacicept-Japan) rebuild the base. Capex includes in-licensing intangibles at a ~¥10bn/yr normalised pace (FY2019-25 average), not the ¥47bn FY2026 spike. Working capital capture -10% (receivables+inventory > payables: decline releases cash, growth consumes it; H1 FY2027 already released ~¥26bn of receivables). Price is the Friday regular close, not after-hours.

base.growth_rationale: Y1 = FY2027 guidance (455.0bn). Y2 -3.5%: Keytruda settlement royalty ends Dec 2026 (~22bn in FY2027, nil after) partly offset by Deciphera +10bn. Y3-Y4: US Opdivo IV biosimilars from 2028 erode the ~35bn US royalty, domestic Opdivo (114bn, -5-8%/yr on NHI cuts and competition) keeps shrinking. Y5-Y6: EU/ROW Opdivo expiry 2030 removes most of the ~90bn ex-US royalty over two years. Y7 flat, Y8-Y10 +1.5-2% as Deciphera (~90bn+), the subQ royalty tail (~40-50bn) and pipeline launches compound off a smaller base. Terminal revenue ~396bn, ~23% below FY2026.
base.margin_rationale: Y1 29.5% = guided core OP 124bn + deductible D&A ~10bn over 455bn (IFRS OP 94 + total D&A 38 gives 29.0%). Royalty is near-pure margin, so each ¥ of royalty lost is ~¥1 of EBITDA lost until costs respond; management commits to R&D >30% of sales through at least FY2027, so the margin falls to 18.5% by FY2032 before R&D normalises toward 25% of sales and new products mature; 21% terminal is mid-pack for a Japanese mid-cap pharma with ~12% royalty content.
base.capex_rationale: PPE ~6bn + in-licensing intangibles ~10bn (FY2019-25 average 10.1bn; FY2026's 47.2bn included one large upfront). Held roughly flat in yen as revenue declines, so the percentage drifts up to 4.2%.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 15x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 30% because the central risk is dated and contractual, not cyclical: a single royalty stream from a single partner (BMS) runs off on a published patent calendar, and FY2025-26 pipeline attrition was unusually high, so the thesis rests on an unproven replacement. Bull cut to 20% because it needs three independent things to go right at once (slow biosimilar erosion plus subQ conversion, Deciphera scaling to $700m+, and two late-stage pipeline wins). Base 50%: the company's own FY2027 guidance anchors year one and the balance sheet removes any solvency dimension.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
